279 |       capture. This tracking strategy is called *true-tracking*. Learn more
280 |       about tracking in

284 |       a simplified 2-D array geometry where the sun's position is

292 |     single-axis tracker:

316 |     # oriented along tracking axis; from north, the y-axis is rotated clockwise
317 |     # by the axis azimuth and tilted from horizontal by the axis tilt. The
318 |     # positive x-axis is 90 deg clockwise from the y-axis and parallel to
319 |     # horizontal (e.g., if the y-axis is south, the x-axis is west); the
320 |     # positive z-axis is normal to the x and y axes, pointed upward.
